edges.reason: burnFrom resolves savings module using MODULE_SAVINGS.
userBalanceChanged resolves savings module using MODULE_SAVINGS.
burnFrom bypasses allowance for savings module.
userBalanceChanged makes external callback to savings module, enabling reentrancy.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter account of PoolToken.userBalanceChanged is directly consumed by the function and forwarded to the external callback.
Parameter from of PoolToken.burnFrom is directly used in the burn path.
Parameter value of PoolToken.burnFrom is directly used as burn amount.
Parameter fromDistribution of _calculateDistributedAmount is directly used in the arithmetic calculation.
Parameter toDistribution of _calculateDistributedAmount bounds the calculation loop.
Parameter initialBalance is the starting balance in _calculateDistributedAmount.
Local next is the loop index in _calculateDistributedAmount.
Local balance is the running balance in _calculateDistributedAmount.
Local da is the per-distribution amount in _calculateDistributedAmount.
Parameter account of _updateUserBalance is the target account whose claim is processed.
Parameter toDistribution of _updateUserBalance controls the claim range.
Local fromDistribution tracks the first unprocessed distribution for _updateUserBalance.
Local distributionAmount is the claimed amount returned by _updateUserBalance.
Parameter module of getModuleAddress is used to build the external staticcall.
Local success of getModuleAddress records staticcall success.
Local result of getModuleAddress stores raw staticcall return data.
Local moduleAddress of getModuleAddress is the decoded module address.
